phase_1.title: Phase 1 · PPSh-41 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×25mm Tokarev primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 210 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 210 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 269 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 488 m/s (655 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Open-Bolt Slam & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 71-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the PPSh-41 staged for its 900–1,000 RPM (Selective Semi / Full-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪：1941 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 格奥尔基·什帕金设计的 PPSh-41 仅需约 7.3 工时即可冲压成型，多孔散热护筒前端自然延伸为斜切膛口制退防跳器；配 71 发发条螺旋弹鼓与高初速 7.62×25mm 瓶形弹，以 900 发/分泼水火力统治东线巷战。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：PPSh-41 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1941 年问世的 波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪 由苏联苏联第 367 兵工厂（ZIS 等）主导研制，定位为经典的高射速弹鼓冲锋枪。斯大林格勒战役期间，红军整连装备 PPSh-41 组成突击群，其 71 发持续弹幕令德军步兵在废墟近战中高度忌惮并大量缴获改膛使用。
格奥尔基·什帕金设计的 PPSh-41 仅需约 7.3 工时即可冲压成型，多孔散热护筒前端自然延伸为斜切膛口制退防跳器；配 71 发发条螺旋弹鼓与高初速 7.62×25mm 瓶形弹，以 900 发/分泼水火力统治东线巷战。 整件装备总长 843 mm（固定桦木托）、空重 3.63 kg，成为同期冲锋枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1941 年，苏联苏联第 367 兵工厂（ZIS 等）推出了划时代的波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪。斯大林格勒战役期间，红军整连装备 PPSh-41 组成突击群，其 71 发持续弹幕令德军步兵在废墟近战中高度忌惮并大量缴获改膛使用。 它的核心设计聚焦于机匣与散热护筒一体化冲压，后端铰链打开即可无工具取出重型枪机与缓冲垫，奠定了其在冲锋枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪 的机械灵魂在于其「自由枪机 · 开膛待击 + 71 发发条弹鼓与斜切护筒制退器」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。散热护筒前端斜切挡板将火药燃气向上导出，有效压制 900 RPM 连发枪口上跳，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪 采用自由枪机 · 开膛待击 + 71 发发条弹鼓与斜切护筒制退器。在每个击发周期中，重型枪机自后方阻铁释放前冲完成推弹、闭膛与惯性击发循环。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了散热护筒前端斜切挡板将火药燃气向上导出，有效压制 900 RPM 连发枪口上跳。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×25mm Tokarev 弹药规格与 269 mm 镀铬内膛 · 4 条右旋膛线（1:240 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 210 MPa，可赋予弹头 488 m/s 的出膛初速与 655 J 动能，有效作用距离达 200 米。
内膛技术特点方面，镀铬 4 条右旋膛线耐腐蚀底火烧蚀，常由莫辛步枪毛坯截半加工而成。同时，71 发双层发条弹鼓与高速 7.62×25mm 瓶形弹提供压倒性近距火力密度，令其在 900–1,000 发/分（快慢机可选单/连发） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 269 毫米身管与 7.62×25mm Tokarev 口径，波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪 实现了每秒 488 米的初速与 200 米有效射程。镀铬 4 条右旋膛线耐腐蚀底火烧蚀，常由莫辛步枪毛坯截半加工而成，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 71 发容量的大容量圆鼓/螺旋弹筒壳体与 36 mm 膛轴设计，波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 3.9 N·s 水平。全镀铬枪管内膛无惧严寒与腐蚀性底火，战时总产量突破 600 万支。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-59）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 71 发容量的大容量圆鼓/螺旋弹筒壳体与出色的整体工效，全镀铬枪管内膛无惧严寒与腐蚀性底火，战时总产量突破 600 万支。欢迎在 BAY-59 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 波波沙 PPSh-41 7.62mm 弹鼓冲锋枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the PPSh-41
paragraphs: Introduced in 1941 by Factory No. 367 / ZIS in USSR, the Shpagin PPSh-41 emerged as a defining High-Cadence Drum-Fed Submachine Gun. During Stalingrad, entire Red Army submachine-gun companies carried the PPSh-41, whose 71-round volume of fire made captured examples prized by Wehrmacht troops.

Engineered by Georgy Shpagin for 7.3-hour stamped-steel production, the PPSh-41 extends its perforated barrel jacket into an angled muzzle brake, feeding bottleneck 7.62×25mm Tokarev rounds from a 71-round drum at 900+ RPM. Measuring 843 mm (Fixed Birch Wood Stock) at an unloaded weight of 3.63 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Submachine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1941, Factory No. 367 / ZIS of USSR introduced the Shpagin PPSh-41. During Stalingrad, entire Red Army submachine-gun companies carried the PPSh-41, whose 71-round volume of fire made captured examples prized by Wehrmacht troops. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Hinged stamped-steel upper pivots open for tool-free bolt removal and fiber buffer swap — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Shpagin PPSh-41 sits its Simple Blowback · Open-Bolt Action with 71-Round Clockwork Drum & Integral Slanted Compensator. Throughout every firing cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia, containing 210 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Integral slanted compensator plate vents muzzle blast upward to tame 900 RPM climb, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Shpagin PPSh-41 relies on Simple Blowback · Open-Bolt Action with 71-Round Clockwork Drum & Integral Slanted Compensator. During each cycle, heavy open bolt strips a cartridge on its forward lunge and fires via fixed-pin inertia. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Integral slanted compensator plate vents muzzle blast upward to tame 900 RPM climb.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×25mm Tokarev with 269 mm Chrome-Lined Bore · 4-Groove RH Rifling (1:240 mm Twist), the Shpagin PPSh-41 develops 488 m/s muzzle velocity and 655 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 200 meters.

Internally, Chrome-lined 4-groove right-hand rifling resisted corrosive primers and was commonly cut from halved Mosin barrel blanks. Combined with its 900–1,000 RPM (Selective Semi / Full-Auto) tempo, 71-round clockwork drum and flat-shooting 7.62×25mm bottleneck rounds dominated urban combat, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×25mm Tokarev through its 269 millimeter bore, the Shpagin PPSh-41 achieves 488 meters per second and 200 meters of effective reach. Chrome-lined 4-groove right-hand rifling resisted corrosive primers and was commonly cut from halved Mosin barrel blanks.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 71-round high-capacity drum magazine body with a 36 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 3.9 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Chrome-lined bore withstood sub-zero winters and corrosive primers across 6+ million built.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-59), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
